item.description: The method always creates HTTP1Record instances for exceptions, even when dealing with HTTP/2 requests. This prevents HTTP/2 records from being properly tracked when exceptions occur, causing all HTTP/2 tests to fail because no records are created.
item.contract: Modify the add_new_record_exception method to detect HTTP/2 protocol context and create HTTP2Record instances when appropriate, rather than always defaulting to HTTP1Record. The method should support both HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 record types based on the request context.
item.acceptance: Tests in tests/test_hook_h2.py should pass, specifically the ones that check for record creation with HTTP/2 protocol identification.
